name: CincinV2.24
summary: CincinV2.24 is a scalping EA that enters trades on small timeframe price movements using a combination of technical indicators for signal generation. It aims to capture quick profits with tight take-profit targets and employs a systematic approach to trade management. The EA is designed for high-frequency trading on lower timeframes with rapid entry and exit logic.
summary_zh: CincinV2.24是一个剥头皮EA，利用技术指标组合在小周期价格波动中入场交易。它通过紧密的止盈目标快速获利，采用系统化的交易管理方式。该EA专为低时间框架高频交易设计，具有快速入场和出场逻辑。
strategy_analysis: CincinV2.24采用剥头皮策略，在短周期图表上利用技术指标信号进行快速交易。入场条件基于指标交叉或超买超卖信号，在价格出现小幅波动时迅速进场。出场条件设置了较紧的止盈目标，同时配备止损来控制单笔亏损。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户自定义手数或根据资金比例动态计算。资金管理上建议使用较小的固定手数以降低风险，但由于是剥头皮策略，交易频率较高可能导致累计成本增加。该EA的核心逻辑是快速进出市场，通过大量小盈利累积收益。
strategy_analysis_en: CincinV2.24 employs a scalping strategy that uses technical indicator signals on short timeframe charts for rapid trade execution. Entry conditions are based on indicator crossovers or overbought/oversold signals, entering positions quickly when small price movements are detected. Exit conditions feature tight take-profit targets along with stop-losses to control individual trade losses. Position sizing allows users to define fixed lot sizes or dynamically calculate based on account equity percentage. Money management recommends using smaller fixed lots to reduce risk, but the high trading frequency inherent in scalping can lead to accumulated spread and commission costs. The core logic is rapid market entry and exit, accumulating profits through numerous small winning trades.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 剥头皮策略在小波动市场中能快速累积小额利润
系统化交易消除情绪干扰，严格执行策略规则
紧密的止盈止损设置有助于控制单笔风险
pros_en: Scalping strategy can quickly accumulate small profits in low-volatility markets
Systematic trading eliminates emotional interference with strict rule execution
Tight take-profit and stop-loss settings help control per-trade risk exposure
cons: 高频交易产生的点差和手续费成本可能侵蚀利润
剥头皮策略在趋势市场中容易被反复止损
缺乏趋势过滤机制，可能在不利行情中频繁开仓
cons_en: High-frequency trading generates significant spread and commission costs that can erode profits
Scalping strategy prone to repeated stop-outs during trending market conditions
Lacks trend filter mechanism, potentially opening frequent positions in unfavorable conditions
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如大周期均线）避免逆势交易
加入点差过滤机制，在点差过大时暂停交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe moving average) to avoid counter-trend trades
Implement spread filtering to pause trading when spreads are excessively wide

risk_points: 剥头皮策略在点差扩大时可能导致频繁亏损
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一根K线内重复开仓
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy may result in frequent losses when spreads widen significantly
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position opening within the same candle
